title: Guided Brand Onboarding and Shared Brand Memory Initialization

notes: Onboarding accepts one public HTTP(S) URL and does not require channel authentication.
The public URL is Brand-learning evidence only; authenticated channel connections remain required for publishing and provider insights.
Kairo infers Brand context and goals into the existing Brand Brain/shared Brand Memory model without creating a second intelligence store.
Channel connection moves to Home Needs Attention and Brand connection surfaces after onboarding.
Use the approved Kairo design baseline plus UI UX Pro Max, Impeccable, Emil motion principles, Ponytail, UI Review and Superpowers within their bounded roles.
Motion must be purposeful, short and reduced-motion aware.

approvals.rationale: The Product Owner approved simplifying onboarding to one public URL and moving authenticated channel connection to Home/Brand after onboarding.
Existing source-removal, Meta connection, Brand Learning and publishing policies remain unchanged; a public URL is evidence only and grants no channel authority.
The Product Owner explicitly instructed installation of the approved UI skills and runtime implementation, including purposeful motion where required.
Implementation and automated verification are complete; certification requires human approval bound to the final immutable passing SHA.

postRelease.expectedOutcome: A user gives Kairo one public Brand URL, reviews Kairo's concise understanding, reaches Home, and can connect publishing channels later without repeating Brand setup.
metrics: channel connection prompt shown when no channel is connected
